# teardrop-cli — Full Reference (pinned fixture)

This is a pinned, minimal copy of the upstream `docs/cli-reference.md` Table of
Contents used by `tests/test_cli_contract.py` to validate skill doc anchors.
It is intentionally NOT the full doc — only the `##` headings matter, because
the test derives GitHub anchor slugs from them.

Refresh this file when bumping the `teardrop-cli` pin in `pyproject.toml`, or
when upstream adds/renames a top-level section that skills link to.
